# Analyst brief

Prepare the named task using [task.md](task.md). Own the task document only. Read the relevant specification and current APIs, then give the implementer enough verified context to act without rereading the entire project.

Specify goals, acceptance evidence, owner paths, dependencies, a concise code map, commands, and pitfalls. State concurrent work and preserve its files. Report uncertain design choices rather than inventing product requirements. Do not spawn nested agents.
